<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/users/{user-id}/subscriptions"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Bulk unsubscribe the _specified user_ from mods. Provide no parameters to unsubscribe from all mods, or provide `game_ids` or `mod_ids` to target specific subscriptions. Successful request will return `204 No Content`.<br /><br />__NOTE:__ Users can unsubscribe from mods via mod.io, we recommend you poll or call the [Get Mod Events](/restapi/docs/get-mod-events) endpoint when needed, to keep a user's mods collection up to date.
